title: Battle of Pirajá
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Pirajá", at revision 1375628078, opens: "The Battle of Pirajá was fought as part of the Independence of Bahia and more broadly, as part of the Brazilian War of Independence. It was fought in Pirajá, now a neighborhood of the city of Salvador, Bahia on November 8, 1822. The Battle of Pirajá was the largest engagement in the fight for the independence of Bahia, involving approximately 10,000 troops." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q29607, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1822 battle of the War of Independence of Brazil". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
